items.question: How do I find qualified leads from noisy comment sections?
items.answer: Use intent keyword templates and location filters together. This narrows large comment datasets to prospects who show clear inquiry or purchase signals.

items.question: Do I need to pay to export lead lists?
items.answer: Core export is free. You can download lead data to Excel/CSV and start follow-up immediately without extra setup.

items.question: Can the tool catch slang or abbreviated contact intent?
items.answer: Yes. Add common variants and slang to your keyword template library, and the matcher will flag those comments during extraction.

items.question: Why include profile links and location in lead exports?
items.answer: Profile links are stable identifiers for accurate revisit and follow-up. Location helps local teams prioritize nearby prospects with stronger conversion potential.

items.question: How can teams collaborate on lead follow-up?
items.answer: Sync lead exports to Lark Base and assign owners, status tags, and notes so everyone works from one shared source of truth.

items.question: How many comments should I process per campaign?
items.answer: For viral posts, starting with the latest or most-liked 200-500 comments often captures the strongest commercial signals while keeping analysis manageable.
